rules: Keep Observation Roots separate by physical provenance; a derivative, cache, re-encoding, or publication copy never creates a new root.
Prefer direct gauge observations for claims explicitly about relative sea level at the Longwan station datum.
Use Copernicus altimetry as an independent absolute-sea-level observation root at its own spatial support; do not silently coerce it into the gauge datum.
Preserve the 1993-2020 trend discrepancy as parallel claims plus a derived VLM hypothesis with uncertainty.
Treat exact station coordinates as Unknown until a source-audited metadata record is pinned.
Treat typed-wave phase as Unknown; keep residual required; do not fabricate a fully reconstructible signal from period and amplitude alone.
Never treat statistical projections as observations.
No terrain/water intersection is allowed until vertical datum and placement gates pass.
Every new evidence asset is append-only; prior claims remain addressable and rollback-safe.
